The '''2021–22 Bundesliga''' was the 59th season of the [[Bundesliga]], Germany's premier [[Association football|football]] competition. It began on 13 August 2021 and concluded on 14 May 2022.<ref name="calendar">{{cite news |url=https://www.dfl.de/de/aktuelles/rahmenterminkalender-fuer-die-saison-2021-22-veroeffentlicht/ |title=Rahmenterminkalender für die Saison 2021/22 veröffentlicht |trans-title=Framework schedule for the 2021–22 season published |website=DFL.de |publisher=[[Deutsche Fußball Liga]] |date=4 December 2020 |access-date=27 February 2021 |language=de}}</ref> The fixtures were announced on 25 June 2021.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://media.dfl.de/sites/2/2021/06/Spielplan_Bundesliga_2021_2022.pdf |title=Spielplan Bundesliga 2021/2022|publisher=dfl.de |language=German |date=25 June 2021 |accessdate=25 June 2021}}</ref>

[[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]] were the defending champions and successfully defended their title, winning their record-extending 10th consecutive title and 32nd title overall (31st in the Bundesliga era) on 23 April with three matches to spare. Bayern also became the first ever club in Europe's top five leagues to achieve a tenth consecutive league title, the previous record being [[Juventus FC|Juventus]]' nine consecutive titles from 2012 to 2020.

[[Arminia Bielefeld]] and [[Greuther Furth]] were relegated to the 2. Bundesliga.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2022/apr/23/bayern-munich-v-borussia-dortmund-bundesliga-live?filterKeyEvents=false&page=with:block-626442d68f088371a5f40e83#block-626442d68f088371a5f40e83|title=Bayern Munich 3 Borussia Dortmund 1|date=23 April 2022|work=The Guardian|access-date=25 April 2022}}</ref>

| match_BOC_MÖN_note = The VfL Bochum v Borussia Mönchengladbach match from 18 March 2022 was suspended after 69 minutes and a score of 0–2 due to an assistant referee being hit by a beverage cup thrown from the stands.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.kicker.de/bierbecher-trifft-linienrichter-am-kopf-freitagsspiel-in-bochum-abgebrochen-894783/artikel |title=Bierbecher trifft Linienrichter am Kopf: Freitagsspiel in Bochum abgebrochen |trans-title=Beer mug hits linesman on the head: Friday game in Bochum stopped |work=[[Kicker (sports magazine)|kicker]] |date=18 March 2022 |access-date=18 March 2022 |language=de}}</ref> The match was abandoned and later awarded on 24 March 2022 to Borussia Mönchengladbach with a score of 0–2.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.dfb.de/news/detail/sportgericht-wertet-abgebrochenes-spiel-mit-20-fuer-moenchengladbach-238202/ |title=Sportgericht wertet abgebrochenes Spiel mit 2:0 für Mönchengladbach |trans-title=Sports court scores abandoned match 2–0 for Mönchengladbach |work=[[German Football Association]] |date=24 March 2022 |access-date=24 March 2022}}</ref>

==Relegation play-offs==
The relegation play-offs took place on 19 and 23 May 2022.<ref name="calendar"/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dfb.de/news/detail/termine-fuer-aufstiegsspiele-zur-3-liga-stehen-fest-239509/|title=Termine für Aufstiegsspiele zur 3. Liga fix|website=dfb.de|publisher=[[German Football Association]]|date=29 April 2022|access-date=29 April 2022|language=de}}</ref> The away goals rule is no longer used as of the 2021/22 season.<ref>{{Cite web |title=How does promotion and relegation work in the Bundesliga? |url=https://www.bundesliga.com/[object%20Object]/faq/what-are-the-rules-and-regulations-of-soccer/how-does-promotion-and-relegation-work-in-the-bundesliga-10645 |access-date=2023-05-31 |website=bundesliga.com - the official Bundesliga website |language=en}} {{Dead link|date=September 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>
